videoTitle: Metformin for Low Milk Supply? What the Research Actually Says
videoDescription: You've tried every supplement and pumping schedule—but if you have PCOS, insulin resistance might be blocking your milk production. Here's what one small trial found about metformin as a galactagogue, and why it's not the magic fix most people hope for. Full breakdown at mindtivate.com
script: You've tried every supplement and pump schedule, but if you have PCOS, insulin resistance might be blocking your milk supply—not your effort.
One small trial found metformin increased output by 8 mL versus a 58 mL drop on placebo—but the difference wasn't significant, and no one in the study kept taking it.
Head to mindtivate.com for the full evidence breakdown and what to rule out first.
